newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador coffee output to dip in 96-97 -Procafe.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador coffee output to dip in 96-97 -Procafe.

text.p: Coffee production in El Salvador could be down by up to six percent in the 1996-1997 cycle to around 2.9 million 46-kg bags, a leading coffee investigation group said Tuesday.

Rene Martinez, the manager of the Fundacion Salvadorena para Investigaciones del Cafe, known as Procafe, said irregular rainfall might cause a dip of around 225,000 bags from the output in 1995-1996 cycle.
"We believe output will be down five to six percent," Martinez told Reuters.

He explained that western growing regions have been worst hit by inconsistent rainfall, with a shortage of water over the short summer to January and than an abundance in April, first affecting flowerings and then cherry development.
Sources at the Salvadoran Coffee Council said exports to last week from the 1995-1996 cycle had totaled 2.9 million 46-kg bags.
